描述_EN: stella mccartney's collection for swedish high street chain h&m (hennes & mauritz) was launched in november 2005. h&m hosted the launch with a high profile party in london at the st olaves school building,tower bridge. the party included a catwalk show where models dressed in the collection played musical chairs. the jumpsuit is a garment which often appears in stella mccartney's work for her own main line collections, this light silk, loose fit and soft tie belt are all indicative of her relaxed signature style. the media coverage was extensive and when the line was launched at selected h&m stores there were queues along the street and the stock sold out almost instantly. realising that the demand for pieces would be high the items were for sale at a higher price than they had been in the store. between 2004-2008 the popularity of designer collaborations with high street stores was at a peak. within several hours of release numerous pieces appeared on ebay for sale by customers who had bulk bought .
描述_ZN: 2005年11月，斯特拉-麦卡特尼为瑞典高街连锁店H&M（Hennes & Mauritz）设计的系列正式发布。 H&M在伦敦塔桥的圣奥拉夫学校大楼举办了一场高调的发布会。 该派对包括一个T台秀，模特们穿着该系列的衣服玩音乐椅。 连体裤是一件经常出现在Stella McCartney自己主线系列作品中的服装，这种轻薄的丝绸，宽松的版型和柔软的领带都是她轻松的标志性风格。 媒体报道非常广泛，当该系列在选定的H&M商店推出时，沿街排队，库存几乎瞬间售罄。 意识到对产品的需求会很高，这些产品以比商店里更高的价格出售。 在2004-2008年间，设计师与高街商店合作的流行程度达到了顶峰。 在发布的几个小时内，许多作品出现在Ebay上，被大量购买的客户出售。
